response.sql: SELECT t.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS matched_records FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = a.translink WHERE a.patsim > 0.439 GROUP BY t.ordertypedist

assumptions.assumption: The count is of matched (advancedbehavior, transactionrecord) pairs. Since transreg is the primary key and each translink points to one transaction, this equals the number of qualifying advanced behaviour records per group.
Records with a NULL patsim are excluded because the comparison is not true. A NULL ordertypedist forms its own group, which GROUP BY does by default.
